explanation: The first king of Israel, who fell in battle against the Philistines at Mount Gilboa.
A people living in Canaan and enemies of Israel; they killed Saul and his sons in battle.
A mountain in Israel where the battle between the Israelites and the Philistines took place, and where Saul and his sons died.
One of Saul's sons, known for his friendship with David and his bravery in battle.
The future king of Israel and a central figure in the books of Samuel; he was not present at this battle.
The act of taking one's own life; Saul committed suicide by falling on his own sword to avoid being captured by the Philistines.
A city where the Philistines hung the bodies of Saul and his sons on the city wall as a sign of victory and humiliation.
A city in Israel where the men took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from Beth-Shan and buried them.
